githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.5 Beta 5 adds native pinned messages and an optional iMessage-style bubble layout. It also improves message grouping, makes shared theme links more compact, and streamlines interface settings.

## Pinned messages

- Added a Pinned Messages toolbar popover for server conversations, direct messages, and group direct messages, with paginated history rendered in the native timeline.
- Added permission-aware Pin Message and Unpin Message actions to message menus, with immediate updates and synchronization as Discord reports changes.
- Made pinned messages and their reply references navigable: selecting one closes the popover, opens the source conversation, scrolls to the exact message, and highlights it.
- Improved Discord pin announcement messages with native links to the member, message, and pinned-message list while hiding reply actions that do not apply.

## Message bubbles and rich content

- Added a Bubbles message appearance option in Settings alongside the existing Default layout.
- Added compact incoming and outgoing conversation bubbles, with outgoing messages aligned to the right in the active SakuraCord accent and grouped messages sharing appropriate edges and tails.
- Integrated replies, attachments, embeds, stickers, forwarded messages, threads, SakuraCord link cards, and interactive message components into the bubble layout.
- Improved incremental message grouping so replies and adjacent same-author messages keep the correct group boundaries as history changes.

## Themes and interface settings

- Shortened shared theme links by omitting inactive gradient colors while preserving compatibility with links created by earlier betas.
- Removed the message-density, sidebar-density, and custom text-size controls, standardizing SakuraCord on its default layout and typography.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5-Beta-4...v0.1.5-Beta-5](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5-Beta-4...v0.1.5-Beta-5)
discordAnnouncement:
**Pinned messages and iMessage-style bubbles 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Open Pinned Messages from the toolbar in server chats and DMs, then jump from any pin or reply to its source
- Pin or unpin messages from their menus when you have permission, with changes reflected immediately
- Choose Bubbles in Appearance for right-aligned accent-colored messages and grouped incoming conversations
- Bubble layouts support replies, attachments, embeds, stickers, forwarded messages, threads, link cards, and interactive components
- Shared theme links are shorter, and Interface settings now use one standard density and text scale
